_note: Illustrative and synthetic. Not production data or a real schema. It shows the SHAPE of an allocation record: an activity record apportioned onto one crop on one field, with a strategy AND a frozen basis snapshot, so a report run today still reproduces tomorrow even if the underlying data changes.
note: Confidence is derived on read, not stored; the universe is inferred from sibling allocations. The snapshot is what makes historical reports reproducible.
